properties.headline: Rip Current Statement issued November 22 at 3:37PM ChST until November 26 at 3:00PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents expected.

* WHERE...East facing reefs of the Marianas.

* WHEN...Through Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A building trade-wind swell will produce a
high risk of rip currents along east facing reefs. Surf and the rip
current risk will also be elevated along north facing reefs, but
remain just below High Surf Advisory and High Rip Current Risk
levels.
properties.instruction:
Rip currents will be life threatening. If caught in a rip
current, relax and float. Don't swim against the current. If
able, swim in a direction following the shoreline. If unable to
escape, face the shore and call or wave for help.

NWSheadline: HIGH RIP CURRENT RISK IN EFFECT THROUGH THURSDAY AFTERNOON
